يمتعضا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضَا (yamtaʕiḍā) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضَا (yumtaʕaḍā) /jum.ta.ʕa.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
